reviews.comment: DON'T TAKE! There are two professors  that switch every exam, which already makes it hard. Slides are ALL pictures and she is off course when she teaches. Only the textbook helps, which is ridiculously long, taking a lot of time, and is hard when you have little to no background context on the subject with nothing to refer to. Avoid.

while dr. qin is very very sweet, her lectures made no sense. she is very boring, and very often what was tested on was not in the lecture and was on a VERY specific section of the book. the book is super long and wordy, but you would need to study it word for word to do well. an A is an 83 though!
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: When I sent her an email asking what chapters would be on the next test (after one of the chapters was skipped on the last test), she called me out in front of the whole class saying how dumb I was. Also, class was split between her and Shogo Sato. Additionally, Dr. Qin was extremely hard to understand, and her slides are useless. Don't recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Two professors that switch off 2 exams with each. Both are very lecture heavy but its hard to understand so it is easier to just memorize quizlets for exams. one prof has practice exams and reuses questions talks a lot with SI leader about what to know. other prof gives reviews and writes must know on slides. overall not the easiest but doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy

reviews.comment: Just memorize quizlet questions bc you're not gonna do well on her exams otherwise. Some of them are identical. She is very sweet, but her exams are tangentially related to her lecture topics, so learning the slides will give you a basic understanding of the content, but it wont help you on the exams. Gives good EC so you need like 83s for an A.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Skip class. Dedicate your life to memorizing the textbook. She is so very sweet but her accent is nearly impossible to understand when trying to explain something complex. Tests are multiple choice tho so that's a pro compared to other 213 profs.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It is incredibly hard to learn anything from the lectures. The slides are all pictures from the textbooks. The only reason I passed this class is because of SI. If you do not want to buy the textbook or do not have time to read it DO NOT TAKE. I trusted myself to read from the book and I did not. She is nice but she can not teach.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin is so so sweet but I found her class hard given the lack of grades for the semester. There's 4 exams, 4 homework's + one extra credit assignment. She's generous with her A starting at an 83 and giving extra credit. Her exams are multiple choice. To do well I read the textbook in bed at night like a grandma getting ready for bed.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you don't read the textbook, you probably won't do well on exams. Lecture and slides are just pictures from the textbook and she just talks about what she remembers but the tests are based on info from the textbook. Her reviews before the test could be helpful because she gives out some clues. She is very sweet but not good at lecturing.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She is a very nice woman, but I learned completely from the textbook. Stopped going to lectures halfway because they weren't helpful. Tests often had material that wasn't covered during in lecture but was in the textbook. Regardless, an A is extremely doable. The A cutoff is 83 and she sometimes curves on top of it. Homework is also free points.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Had to Q drop after the second test, the tests are the majority of your grade and aren't what we went over in lecture. She's a very sweet prof and her accent isn't that bad but if you aren't a textbook person I'd take someone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really nice and approachable, but accent is hard to understand. Has a hard time using mic, can barely hear her lecture. Very few and short homeworks, answers often on quizlet so easy 100s. Class grade is mostly exams, only has 2 then the final. Exams are nothing like lecture slides, just the textbook. Memorize the textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Normally I do not put a lot of stock into online reviews of professors, but I cannot express how difficult this professor made this course. She teaches complex topics in metaphors and stock photos taken from google, and does not seem to care about low test scores. The tests ask incredibly obscure and specific questions. Good luck if you take her.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Biol 213 is really info-heavy and Qin no help. If you don't read the textbook for this class you won't pass I learned that the hard way on my first exam. Luckily, I bounced back and went from a D to an A because of her curves, practice exam, SI, and memorizing the whole textbook. This isn't an easy class so be prepared to spend your days studying.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin is a very sweet professor. Her tests can be difficult and her lectures are somewhat hard to follow. Reading the textbook is essential to pass as the lectures and powerpoint's don't have the detail of her test quesitons. With all of this being said, her cutoff for an A is an 83!!!! It is very easy to stay in the upper 80's and snag the A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Qin gave us practice exams with questions directly from the exams but her lectures were mind numbing. Be prepared to teach yourself everything. If you read and basically memorize the book, youll be fine. 3 tests (non cumulative final included) and some homework for grades. It was fine, but her teaching style is dull and not very helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin is a fair professor, she gives extra credit to make you earn your desired grade. Lectures are a bit boring as she just reads off slides, but reading the textbook is the best form of studying for exams (treat it as your bible and read it like everyday a week before exam LOL).
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I'm not gonna lie, Dr. Qin is a really sweet woman, but I stopped attending her lectures because she really just talks and you can learn it easier by just reading the book. Her exams kind of sucked because they were a little tricky and confusing, despite knowing all the info it's supposed to be over. Everyone got a 60 on the first exam. Meh.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy

reviews.comment: STAY AWAY. Worst Professor ever. You will need to teach yourself. Very heavy accent. Test doesnt reflect the material thought. She doesnt follow the syllabus. She waits couple of days prior to the exam to let you know the chapters covered on the exam. Two days before the exam she covered 2 new chapters.

Very heavy accent. You can barely understand her. She is all over on the material. Took her time at the beginning of the semester than started covering lot of material before the exam. Exams are difficult. Review posted doesnt help much. STAY AWAY. I am all A student and I am struggling taking her class.

Dr. Qin was very sweet all semester and held review sessions for her students before each of the tests. She cares about her class and tries her best to explain all of the concepts. She does have a bit of an accent but it's nothing you can't understand after a couple lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class was not a walk in the park. Take your time on the homework, because every point counts. I thought her exams were overall the most fair among the BIO 213 professors. I took Rao for BIO 111 and it was a lot of the same material that Dr. Hongmin went over. GO TO LECTURE! and actually listen to lecture. Also I recommend going to SI.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin is a super sweet professor. She gave extra credit this year because she understands that everyone is dealing with covid in different ways. I will warn you, her lectures can feel long and boring. Her slides are mostly just pictures, which made learning more difficult. If you read the book and study, you can for sure get the A in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: she's really sweet, but i found her lectures boring. she would go on and on for 1 slide, and her tests barely had to do with covered material. i read the textbook word for word for her exams and still would not manage higher than a 79. the only thing that saved me from a C was her extra credit, so show up to class. go to SI, it will save you!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin is a very caring prof obviously you can tell how much she loves the class "if" you attend lectures. She gives extra credit quizzes that only help your grade. Cell molec isn't a walk in the park but if you read and put In the work you'll be fine. I think i'll end with around a 100 and I'm not the brightest person, but I put in some effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin is a nice professor and her lectures are interesting. However, her exams are quite difficult because she does not give out practice tests or homework. You will have to read the textbook heavily and study hard to prepare for the tests. There is extra credit but I would have still preferred the other professor though.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin's lectures will not put you to sleep. Go to office hours if you do not understand. Very understanding, sweet lady who wants you to do your best. She has pop quizzes that are extra credit, so attend class. Exams are quite difficult because she does not post homework or practice exams. Read the textbook and study hard for the tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is really nice but, he accent is a bit difficult to understand. She does not give practice exams at all and you can only find one online that helps a lot but after that youre on your own. Definitely need to read the book but, that wont completely save you. This class is very hard and after exam I she asks very specific questions. Dont take.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is the best! The people who say that reading the book is not enough are the people that are missing the whole point. Her tests are very conceptual. Reading the book allows you to understand the concepts and big picture of what she wants you to know. You will be fine if you do that and are able to make connections and think critically.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: lots of extra credit but very hard to get an A just by reading the book like old reviews said. She loves the class and wants everyone to succeed, but her explanations of the topics are poor and lecture is hard to follow. Study study study for her tests
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: she's a nice person! but as a prof, you have to work hard to do well. i read the textbook but it wasn't enough to do well. go to si, read the book, and go to her office hours if you don't understand. she gives lots of extra credit my semester and uses test banks. go to class so you know what topics she will test you over. final did have old q's
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin's love for cell biology is what got me through this class. The lectures are hard to understand sometimes and you'll do the majority of your learning through the textbook but going to class every day and watching your professor light up over membrane transport will light up your whole semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Qin was the nicest lady and probably the best Biology professor I've had at A&M. However, going to lecture alone will not get you an A. Read the textbook and go to SI. She gave extra credit quizzes, and let us know beforehand when those would be. Tests could be tricky. The final was one of the easier tests including questions from old exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She's SO sweet and really cares that students learn and enjoy Biology. Her lectures are very difficult to focus in because she lectures directly off a powerpoint. She's passionate about the material which helps. She gives "pop" quizzes, which are all bonus toward your grade. READ READ! Reading the textbook well will pretty much guarantee you an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Hongmin QUIN WAS A GREAT PROFFESOR!!

Exams were tough, definitely read the book to do well on her tests. Also, go to all her lectures as she has pop quizzes that are "extra credit" and will not hurt your grade. The final exam was cumulative, but most if not all the questions were from old tests. During my semester, there was a huge curve. Definitely recommend her overall!
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a very experienced instructor.  She put heavy materials in the mid of the semester, so you are not going to get overwhelmed at the end of the semester. You will do well as long as you follow her lectures and do your part of study.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: The lectures are painful. They consist of pictures from the book, and she goes VERY fast. Accent isn't super easy to understand. The only grades in the course are 3 exams & a final. She gives extra credit, but it's very minimal. Exams are VERY content heavy. We just had an exam over 7 chapters, and they weren't light chapters. Would not recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is easy to talk to and her lectures are organized. Make sure you attend the classes so you gain points from quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She makes sure that the chapter objectives are clear and lectures with organized materials. In addition, she gives pop quizzes, so be sure to attend the classes to get better grades. The exams are not entirely from past old ones, so make sure you do understand the materials taught in class.

Dr. Qin is obviously very enthusiastic about what she teaches. However, she uses a test bank (obviously) for her tests, and as such, sometimes is unable to answer questions regarding the correct answer choices after. Furthermore, there is a language barrier evident in her lectures, which are mostly (if not all) images from the textbook.

Her English is pretty good, but someone will ask her if a topic will be on the exam and she would say no and it would show up on the exam. This happened multiple times. She's a nice person so I don't think she lied, but she is disorganized when it comes to exams.
Her lectures are very organized. You also earn extra points through pop quiz. Make you you attend the lectures for extra credit. She is a master instructor.  I really like her.
Her spoken English is pretty good. Moreover, she takes teaching very seriously and is willing to help students out in and outside the classroom. I really like her and think she is good professor.
Do not rely on past exams.  She has pop quizzes. You will have better grades if you attend the classes.
She's impossible to understand even though she knows a lot about cellular biology. Read the parts of the book that correspond to her lecture slides.

Hongmin is incredibly knowledgeable, however, has a hard time expressing it.  She is disorganized in lecture and at times condescending in office hours.  Relied heavily on the book.  As long as you memorize the notes you're golden for essay exams.

She seems nice, but impossible to understand. Her lectures are erratic and have no structure at all. What's most frustrating is that her grammar is so terrible, it take her so long to finish a thought. She also admitted to not being able to pronounce most of the words in the textbook
This teacher does not know much about cell biology that she has been teaching.
